clue.text: Reason I have to be seen by doctor — temperature

parts.note: MO is the Medical Officer, a standard doctor abbreviation
contracted, I have becomes I'VE

explanation.surface: Someone explains why they must see a doctor: they have a temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: A motive is the reason or purpose that drives a person to act.

clue.text: This fellow interrupting me a bit is a wally

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: one word breaking into another means it is placed inside, splitting the phrase a bit

parts.note: a bit is a tad, so A TAD
this fellow is HE

explanation.surface: Someone complains that a man butting in on them is an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: WALLY is British slang for a foolish person.
explanation.definitionFit: A meathead is slang for a stupid person, a dimwit or fool.

clue.text: A court may have such rigid principles

definitions.meaning: a tennis court has parallel side lines marking the doubles alley
figuratively, fixed lines of thinking one cannot depart from

explanation.surface: A law court is said to follow inflexible rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Court' suggests law, but it is a tennis court with its pairs of side lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Tramlines are the doubles side lines on a tennis court and, figuratively, a set course of thinking that cannot be varied.

clue.text: A politician overcome by very seductive woman

indicators.note: in a down entry, being overcome by something puts that thing on top

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A politician is undone by a highly seductive woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A vamp is a woman who uses her charms to seduce and exploit men, a femme fatale.

clue.text: Excellent person protecting weak old colleague

indicators.note: the excellent person surrounds and so shelters the two short letters

parts.note: a corker is an excellent or outstanding person

explanation.surface: A splendid person looks after a frail elderly workmate.
explanation.definitionFit: A coworker is a fellow worker, someone you are employed alongside.

clue.text: Old boy with bits of firewood, any number being in particular shapes

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

indicators.note: the number sits inside the word for the firewood pieces

parts.note: logs are pieces of firewood
N stands for an indefinite number in maths

explanation.surface: A former pupil arranges sticks for the fire in some special shapes.
explanation.definitionFit: Oblongs are rectangles longer than they are wide, a specific kind of shape.

clue.text: Dour leftie, strangely not one taking a silly position

definitions.text: not one taking a silly position

indicators.note: letters arranged strangely are put into an unusual new order

explanation.surface: A sullen left-winger is oddly not one to take a foolish stance.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, silly point and silly mid-on are fielding positions very close to the batter; a player in the deep is the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket fielders far from the bat are the opposite of those placed in the close-catching 'silly' positions.

clue.text: King deceived over one exotic material for garment?

indicators.note: in a down entry the earlier pieces sit over the next one

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
had, as in 'you've been had', means tricked
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A monarch was tricked about a foreign fabric for clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Khadi is a handspun, handwoven cotton cloth from India, used for clothing.

clue.text: Agree to the photographer's request again, being calm

definitions.text: Agree to the photographer's request again
definitions.meaning: to pose a second time for the camera
a state of rest, tranquillity or composure

explanation.surface: A model obliges the photographer with another pose, staying serene.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two parts it means posing once more; as one word it is rest and tranquillity.

clue.text: The first person encountered in Paris, a girl lacking sophistication

parts.words: The first person encountered in Paris
parts.note: the French for I, the first-person pronoun, is je
June is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A traveller's first acquaintance in Paris is an unworldly girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Jejune means naive and simplistic, or dull and insipid.

clue.text: A tricky ramble by two lakes — one sounds a warning

indicators.note: a tricky walk takes twists, so these letters take a new order

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake, twice

explanation.surface: A difficult hike past a pair of lakes gives someone cause for concern.
explanation.definitionFit: An alarm bell rings to alert people to danger, fire or intrusion.

clue.text: Walk quietly following vehicle

indicators.note: the quiet letter comes after the vehicle

parts.note: a tram is a passenger vehicle on rails
P, piano, is the music direction for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone walks softly behind a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: To tramp is to walk heavily or trudge a long way.

clue.text: Devoted to God completely, by the sound of it

indicators.note: signals that the word meaning completely is heard, not written

parts.note: wholly means completely

explanation.surface: Someone seems utterly dedicated to God.
explanation.definitionFit: Holy means sacred, dedicated or consecrated to God.

clue.text: Numbers of clothes items — designer has one put at front

indicators.note: the designer with one goes before the clothing items

parts.note: Mary Quant was a famous British fashion designer
I is the Roman numeral one
ties are items of clothing

explanation.surface: A designer puts one of a batch of garments in a shop's front display.
explanation.walkthrough: Mary Quant was the London designer associated with the miniskirt.
explanation.definitionFit: Quantities are amounts or numbers, as in quantities of goods.

clue.text: Party network embraces fashionable female holding power over men?

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: the network holds the fashionable word inside it

parts.note: a matrix is a grid or network
in means fashionable

explanation.surface: At a party, a web of contacts includes a stylish woman with influence over men.
explanation.definitionFit: A dominatrix is a woman who takes the dominant role in sadomasochistic sexual activity, often with male partners.

clue.text: Sort of creature that could give a lion heading off meat

indicators.note: signals that the letters could be rearranged to give something new
the first letter is cut off the big cat

parts.note: taken as written before its first letter goes

explanation.surface: A lion heading off with some meat suggests a kind of animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' removes L to leave ION, which with MEAT is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: An amniote is any vertebrate whose embryo develops in an amnion: reptiles, birds and mammals.

clue.text: Early missionary returning to hard group of natives

indicators.note: the missionary's name is read backwards

parts.note: Silas travelled with Paul as an early Christian missionary
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: An early missionary goes back to a tough tribe of local people.
explanation.definitionFit: The Salish are a group of Native American peoples of the Pacific Northwest.

clue.text: Excited son and I chant to show support

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: An eager son and I chant to cheer someone on.
explanation.definitionFit: A stanchion is an upright post or bar providing support.

clue.text: Once again considered as being out of uncle's care?

definitions.meaning: uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker; goods bought back from pawn are no longer in his keeping

explanation.surface: Someone, judged afresh, is no longer looked after by an uncle.
explanation.walkthrough: Uncle is old British slang for a pawnbroker.
explanation.definitionFit: Split, the word means judged anew; whole, it means recovered from a pawnbroker by repaying the loan.

clue.text: A female keeping home bright

indicators.note: the female holds the word for home inside

parts.note: she is a female pronoun
in means at home

explanation.surface: A woman keeps her house sparkling.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashine is a literary adjective meaning shining or radiant.

clue.text: Board of chaps wanting head to leave school

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for chaps is dropped

parts.note: chaps are men
to school is to train

explanation.surface: A school's governing board lacks a head who wishes to depart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board' looks like a committee noun; it is the verb, to get on.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrain is to board a train.

clue.text: Marriage guidance organisation led by quiet priest

indicators.note: the organisation is preceded by the quiet letter

parts.note: P, piano, is the music direction for quiet
Relate is the UK relationship counselling charity, formerly Marriage Guidance

explanation.surface: A counselling service is run by a soft-spoken clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: Relate is a British charity offering couples counselling.
explanation.definitionFit: A prelate is a high-ranking churchman such as a bishop.

clue.text: Learned person — female in boat on the Cam?

indicators.note: the woman's name is placed inside the boat

parts.note: punts are flat boats poled along the Cam in Cambridge
Di is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A scholar is pictured as a woman in a punt at Cambridge.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cam is the river through Cambridge, famous for punting.
explanation.definitionFit: A pundit is an expert or learned authority, originally a Hindu scholar.

clue.text: Female to go abroad — one not completing the course

parts.note: aller is French for to go

explanation.surface: A woman travels overseas and drops out of her course of study.
explanation.definitionFit: In horse racing, a horse that falls at a fence fails to finish the race.

clue.text: Relieving naughty brat in cage

indicators.note: naughty letters misbehave and fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A badly behaved child kept in a cage is getting some relief.
explanation.definitionFit: In psychology, abreaction is releasing repressed emotion by reliving an experience, which brings relief.

clue.text: Grand girl about to come to go to the top

indicators.text: to come to go to the top
indicators.note: in a down entry the word for about is placed above the girl

parts.note: re means about or concerning
gal is an informal word for girl

explanation.surface: A grand girl is about to rise to the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: Regal means royal and stately, hence grand and magnificent.

clue.text: Unfortunate condition some children care about

indicators.note: the hidden letters are turned about, read backwards
only some of the letters of the words are used

explanation.surface: Some children have to deal with a sad state of affairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Acne is a skin condition of spots and pimples, an unwelcome affliction.

clue.text: Tree not entirely visible in mist

indicators.note: the tree's name is not given in full, its last letter going

parts.note: the hazel is a tree

explanation.surface: A tree is only partly seen through the fog.
explanation.definitionFit: A haze is a thin mist or vapour that obscures the view.

clue.text: Time to bring two sides together for a drink

indicators.note: the two side letters are brought round the period
the two sides close in to meet around the word for time

parts.note: L and R stand for left and right, the two sides
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: It is time to reconcile two opposing parties over a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Lager is a light, bottom-fermented beer.

clue.text: Going about country, man is treated badly — brutishness

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the country
letters treated badly are knocked about into a new order

parts.note: Mali is a West African country

explanation.surface: Travelling around a nation, a man suffers cruel treatment that shows brutality.
explanation.definitionFit: Animalism means behaviour driven by physical, beastly instincts, hence brutishness.

clue.text: An extra pill ultimately working as tension-reducer

indicators.note: letters set working are reworked into a new arrangement
ultimately points to the last letter of the word pill

explanation.surface: One more tablet eventually takes effect and calms someone down.
explanation.definitionFit: A relaxant is a drug or agent that relieves muscle or nervous tension.

clue.text: Liqueur has agent reeling round — sign of tiredness

indicators.note: the agent spins round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a rep, sales representative, is an agent
a nod of the head shows someone dozing off

explanation.surface: A drunk salesman staggers about, nodding off over his liqueur.
explanation.definitionFit: Pernod is a French brand of aniseed-flavoured spirit, a liqueur.
